item.title: Sustainable Finance Specialist - Integrated Watershed Management
item.description: This UN Volunteer assignment supports the European Commission-funded Sustainable Watershed Management Project in India. Based in New Delhi, the specialist will analyze existing financing mechanisms and develop a sustainable finance framework for watershed management. You will work closely with UNEP teams, government agencies, and financial institutions to identify investment opportunities and document project insights for the India pilot case.
item.author: UNEP India (New Delhi)

item.title: Product Manager - Sustainability & Climate AI Solutions
item.description: This role involves leading the development and commercialization of AI-driven solutions for MSCI's Sustainability and Climate product suite. You will collaborate with engineering, research, and data teams to build AI agents and insights platforms that serve regulated financial clients. The position requires bridging technical AI capabilities with complex climate data structures to deliver scalable value for global investors.
item.author: MSCI Inc. (Remote (India))

item.title: Manager - Special Projects & Sustainability
item.description: This role manages strategic sustainability projects focused on renewable energy, waste-to-wealth initiatives, and resource efficiency across manufacturing sites. You will identify emerging technologies, build data-driven business cases, and oversee end-to-end project execution from design to commissioning. The position requires bridging technical engineering requirements with financial modeling to deliver measurable environmental and commercial value for the organization.
item.author: United Breweries Ltd. (Bengaluru)

item.title: Senior Sector Expert – Building Energy Efficiency
item.description: ASCI is hiring a Senior Sector Expert to advance building energy efficiency initiatives in New Delhi. Working closely with government bodies, the expert will drive scalable energy-saving interventions across commercial and residential sectors.
item.author: ASCI (New Delhi)

item.title: Senior Regulatory Specialist - Toxicology
item.description: This role supports Ecolab’s global toxicology team by managing environmental toxicity testing and ecological hazard assessments for chemical products. You will work within the Global Business Services unit in Pune to ensure compliance with international safety frameworks across the IMEA and AP regions. The position requires strong technical expertise in environmental fate and chemical risk assessment to guide product stewardship efforts.
item.author: Ecolab (Pune)
